svg.title: A PGM file is the picture in memory
svg.desc: The heart written as a text P2 file and as a binary P5 file. After the header, P5 holds forty-two pixel bytes, exactly the indexed image the codec uses.
svg.text: A PGM file is the picture in memory
After a short header, the bytes are the pixels, row by row.
heart.pgm as binary (P5): header, then 42 pixel bytes
Every pixel is one byte: its gray level, which is also its color
register. The codec reads and writes this layout unchanged.
